# Requirements Document

## 1. Application Overview

**Application Name:** posifypro

**Description:** A multi-tenant POS (Point of Sale) SaaS system designed for businesses requiring role-based access control, real-time sales management, inventory tracking, and employee performance monitoring. The system implements a one-time payment licensing model with strict role-based permissions across three user types: SuperAdmin, Owner, and Cashier.

---

## 2. Users and Usage Scenarios

### 2.1 Target Users

- **SuperAdmin**: System administrators responsible for managing multiple tenants, monitoring system health, and overseeing global operations
- **Owner**: Business owners who manage their specific tenant, including sales analytics, inventory, employees, and financial reports
- **Cashier**: Front-line staff handling daily sales transactions, receipt printing, and shift management
- **Visitors**: Potential customers browsing the public landing page to learn about the system

### 2.2 Core Usage Scenarios

- SuperAdmin monitors system-wide tenant activities and validates license activations
- Owner analyzes business performance through real-time dashboards and manages operational resources
- Cashier processes customer transactions quickly and efficiently during business hours
- Visitors explore system features and value proposition before registering

---

## 3. Page Structure and Functional Description

### 3.1 Page Structure

```
posifypro System
├── Public Landing Page (/) [New]
├── Authentication
│   ├── Login Page (/login)
│   └── Registration Page (/register)
├── License Activation Module
└── Dashboard (Role-based)
    ├── Header (Common)
    ├── Sidebar (Role-specific)
    └── Main Content Area
        ├── SuperAdmin Views
        │   ├── Dashboard Overview
        │   ├── Businesses Registered
        │   ├── Users & Roles
        │   ├── Reports & Analytics
        │   └── Settings
        ├── Owner Views
        │   ├── Dashboard Overview
        │   ├── Point of Sale
        │   ├── Products
        │   ├── Reports
        │   ├── Staff
        │   └── Settings
        └── Cashier Views
            ├── Dashboard Overview
            ├── Point of Sale
            ├── Products
            ├── Sales History
            └── Profile
```

### 3.2 Public Landing Page (/)

#### 3.2.1 Hero Section
- Displays headline highlighting core value proposition
- Displays subheadline providing additional context
- Contains two CTA buttons:
  - Get Started button linking to /register
  - Login button linking to /login
- Uses Deep Slate primary color (#0F172A) and Emerald accents (#10B981)

#### 3.2.2 Features/Highlights Section
- Showcases key capabilities of the POS system
- Displays feature cards with icons and descriptions
- Highlights role-based access control, real-time analytics, inventory management, and multi-tenant architecture

#### 3.2.3 Pricing/Value Proposition Section
- Presents one-time payment licensing model
- Emphasizes value benefits and cost savings
- Includes visual elements supporting the pricing message

#### 3.2.4 Customer Reviews/Testimonials Section
- Displays customer testimonials with quotes
- Shows customer names and business types
- Uses professional layout with consistent styling

#### 3.2.5 Footer
- Contains navigation links to key pages
- Displays copyright information
- Includes contact or support links
- Uses Deep Slate background with appropriate contrast

#### 3.2.6 Design Requirements
- Professional and premium visual design
- Consistent use of Deep Slate primary (#0F172A) and Emerald accents (#10B981)
- Responsive layout adapting to desktop and mobile devices
- No authentication required to view landing page

### 3.3 Authentication Pages

#### 3.3.1 Registration Page (/register)
- User inputs business name, email, password, and selects initial role
- System creates new tenant record with is_activated set to false
- Generates unique license_key for the tenant

#### 3.3.2 Login Page (/login)
- User inputs email and password
- System validates credentials and returns JWT token containing user role and tenant information
- Redirects to License Activation Module if tenant is not activated
- Redirects to role-specific Dashboard if tenant is activated

### 3.4 License Activation Module

- Displays license_key and payment instructions
- User submits payment confirmation
- System validates payment entry in database
- Updates is_activated flag to true upon successful payment verification
- Grants access to Dashboard after activation

### 3.5 Dashboard Layout

#### 3.5.1 Header (Common to All Roles)
- Displays Business Name from tenant record
- Shows personalized greeting: \"Welcome [Username]\"
- Displays live-updating Date/Time clock (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS Day)
- Responsive design adapting to different screen sizes

#### 3.5.2 Sidebar (Role-specific)

**SuperAdmin Sidebar:**
- Dashboard Overview: System-wide metrics and key performance indicators
- Businesses Registered: List and manage all registered tenants
- Users & Roles: Manage user accounts and role assignments across tenants
- Reports & Analytics: Aggregated statistics and insights across all tenants
- Settings: System configuration and global preferences

**Owner Sidebar:**
- Dashboard Overview: Real-time sales data, trends, and business performance summary
- Point of Sale: Sales transaction interface for processing customer purchases
- Products: Product catalog, stock levels, and inventory management
- Reports: Revenue summaries, sales analytics, and financial reports
- Staff: Employee management, performance tracking, and activity logs
- Settings: Business configuration and preferences

**Cashier Sidebar:**
- Dashboard Overview: Current shift summary and personal performance metrics
- Point of Sale: Fast product selection and checkout interface
- Products: Read-only view of product availability and pricing
- Sales History: Transaction records for current and past shifts
- Profile: Personal information and shift management

#### 3.5.3 Main Content Area

**SuperAdmin Views:**
- Dashboard Overview: Displays system health metrics, total tenants, active users, and revenue trends using Recharts visualizations (line charts, bar charts, pie charts)
- Businesses Registered: Table listing all tenants with registration date, activation status, and license details
- Users & Roles: Table showing all users across tenants with role assignments and activity status
- Reports & Analytics: Interactive charts and graphs showing tenant growth, revenue distribution, and usage patterns using Recharts
- Settings: Form for system configuration options

**Owner Views:**
- Dashboard Overview: Real-time sales dashboard with revenue charts, top-selling products, and sales trends using Recharts (area charts, bar charts, donut charts)
- Point of Sale: Product grid with search, category filters, shopping cart, and checkout functionality
- Products: Product management table with add/edit/delete capabilities, stock alerts, and inventory tracking
- Reports: Financial reports with date range filters, revenue breakdowns, and profit analysis using Recharts visualizations
- Staff: Employee list with performance metrics, activity logs, and shift summaries
- Settings: Business profile, tax settings, receipt customization, and user preferences

**Cashier Views:**
- Dashboard Overview: Current shift summary with sales count, total revenue, and personal performance metrics displayed using Recharts (simple bar charts, number cards)
- Point of Sale: Simplified product selection interface with quick checkout and receipt printing
- Products: Read-only product catalog with search and category browsing
- Sales History: Transaction log for current and previous shifts with date filters
- Profile: Personal information display, shift clock in/out, and password change functionality

**Data Visualization Requirements:**
- All dashboard views must use Recharts library for charts and graphs
- Charts should be responsive and adapt to different screen sizes
- Use consistent color schemes across all visualizations
- Include tooltips and legends for better data interpretation

#### 3.5.4 UI/UX Design Requirements

- Professional and clean interface using Tailwind CSS
- Typography: Inter or Montserrat font family
- Consistent color palettes across all components
- High-contrast spacing for improved readability
- Premium sidebar-based dashboard layout
- Responsive design supporting desktop and tablet devices

---

## 4. Business Rules and Logic

### 4.1 Landing Page Access

- Public landing page (/) is accessible without authentication
- Get Started button redirects to /register
- Login button redirects to /login
- Landing page uses Deep Slate primary (#0F172A) and Emerald accents (#10B981) from existing design system

### 4.2 RBAC Architecture

- Every API request must include JWT token in authorization header
- Backend validates user role on every request via AuthMiddleware
- Role permissions are strictly enforced:
  - SuperAdmin: Full system access across all tenants
  - Owner: Full access within their own tenant only
  - Cashier: Limited access to sales and basic inventory within their tenant
- Unauthorized access attempts return 403 Forbidden response

### 4.3 Multi-tenant Isolation

- Each tenant operates in isolated data space
- Users can only access data belonging to their tenant (except SuperAdmin)
- Tenant ID is extracted from JWT and used to filter all database queries

### 4.4 License Activation Flow

- New tenants start with is_activated = false
- Dashboard access is blocked until payment is verified
- Payment verification checks for valid entry in payment/license table
- License activation is one-time and permanent
- Activated tenants have unrestricted access to their role-specific features

### 4.5 Sidebar Rendering Logic

- Sidebar components are rendered based on user role extracted from JWT
- Use useMemo to optimize sidebar rendering performance
- Sidebar state persists across page navigation within dashboard

### 4.6 Date/Time Clock

- Header clock updates every second
- Displays current date and time in user's local timezone
- Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS Day (e.g., 2026-06-08 14:37:09 Monday)

### 4.7 Data Visualization

- All charts and graphs must be rendered using Recharts library
- Chart data is fetched from backend APIs and updated in real-time
- Charts must handle empty data states gracefully with appropriate messages

---

## 5. Exception and Boundary Conditions

| Scenario | Handling |
|----------|----------|
| Invalid JWT token | Return 401 Unauthorized, redirect to Login Page |
| Expired JWT token | Return 401 Unauthorized, redirect to Login Page |
| User attempts to access unauthorized resource | Return 403 Forbidden with error message |
| Tenant not activated attempts dashboard access | Redirect to License Activation Module |
| Payment verification fails | Display error message, keep tenant in non-activated state |
| Database connection failure | Display system error message, log error for SuperAdmin review |
| Sidebar component fails to load | Display fallback UI, log error |
| Receipt printer not connected (Cashier) | Display warning message, allow manual receipt generation |
| Invalid license_key format | Reject registration, display validation error |
| Duplicate business name registration | Allow registration (business names can be duplicated across tenants) |
| Chart data fails to load | Display error message in chart area, allow retry |
| Empty data for charts | Display \"No data available\" message with appropriate icon |
| Landing page fails to load | Display error message, provide retry option |

---

## 6. Acceptance Criteria

1. Visitor accesses root route (/), views public landing page with hero section, features, pricing, testimonials, and footer without authentication
2. Visitor clicks Get Started button on landing page, redirects to /register
3. Visitor clicks Login button on landing page, redirects to /login
4. User registers a new business account, receives unique license_key, and is_activated flag is set to false in database
5. User logs in with valid credentials, receives JWT token containing role and tenant information
6. System redirects non-activated tenant to License Activation Module, blocking dashboard access
7. User completes payment, system verifies payment entry, updates is_activated to true
8. User accesses Dashboard, sees role-specific sidebar with updated navigation items (Dashboard Overview, Businesses Registered, Users & Roles, Reports & Analytics, Settings for SuperAdmin; Dashboard Overview, Point of Sale, Products, Reports, Staff, Settings for Owner; Dashboard Overview, Point of Sale, Products, Sales History, Profile for Cashier)
9. User navigates through sidebar items, main content area dynamically updates with corresponding views featuring Recharts visualizations
10. Backend validates JWT and role on every API request, returns appropriate data or error response
11. User logs out, JWT is invalidated, subsequent requests are rejected

---

## 7. Out of Scope for Current Release

- Multi-language support
- Mobile application (iOS/Android)
- Offline mode or local data caching
- Advanced reporting with custom date ranges and filters
- Integration with third-party accounting software
- Automated email notifications for low inventory or sales milestones
- Customer loyalty program features
- Multi-currency support
- Tax calculation automation
- Barcode scanner integration
- Employee scheduling and payroll management
- Subscription-based recurring payment model
- API access for third-party integrations
- White-label customization options
- Data export to CSV/Excel formats
- Audit logs for all user actions
- Two-factor authentication (2FA)
- Password reset via email
- User profile customization (avatar, preferences)
- Dark mode theme option
- Landing page A/B testing
- SEO optimization for landing page
- Analytics tracking on landing page
- Live chat support widget
